shape: Krea 2 Turbo responds best to concise visual descriptors: the subject first, then photographic specifics such as lens or film look, the direction and quality of the light, the colour palette and the framing. Write one comma-separated line of descriptors, under about 60 words.

examples.rough: a woman reading in a cafe
examples.enhanced: a woman reading a paperback in a sunlit corner cafe, soft window light from the left, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field, 85mm portrait lens, candid, natural skin texture
weathered wooden fishing boat tied to a stone pier at dawn, low sun glowing through morning mist, cool blue shadows with a warm rim light, wide angle, film grain, calm still water

examples.rough: neon sign that says OPEN in a rainy street
examples.enhanced: a glowing neon sign reading "OPEN" above a rain-slick city street at night, magenta and cyan reflections in the puddles, shallow focus, 35mm street photograph, moody contrast

examples.rough: an adult couple naked on a sofa, explicit, late evening
examples.enhanced: an adult couple naked on a worn leather sofa, explicit, bodies pressed together, late evening, warm lamp light from the right, deep amber shadows, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens, candid, natural skin texture
